Hand-written shapes, never produced by running herdr. Each is the JSON or text the herdr adapter
(scripts/backends/herdr.py) parses, read by tests/test_backend_herdr.py:
  agent-list*.json       list_seats
  agent-get*.json        get_seat
  pane-get.json          get_terminal
  process-info*.json     processes (also tests/test_roster.py)
  agent-wait*.json       wait_state
  error-*                _error_code (stderr error.code; an error as a plain string; plain-text agent_blocked)
  agent-read.txt         read_output (plain pane text on stdout)
